$Comment: How a Lootable reward READS where a screen shows it before it pays out. A lootable names a
loot table that is only ROLLED at the moment it is handed over, so no specific item can be
promised ahead of time; every one reads as the same generic bundle instead.
This file is presentation only: it names no Command, so the built-in Lootable handler keeps
the payout, and nothing here changes what is rolled.
NameKey - one label for every lootable reward ('Loot Bundle'), shipped by this library in
Icon    - a chest, the shape a player already reads as a bundle opened on receipt.
A reward may still write its own NameKey or Icon to read as something more specific. To
re-skin every lootable reward at once, ship a file with THIS name in your own pack; it
Name: Rolled loot table
